reason: The original Qwen3-VL-2B q10 fixed-64 run overlapped the tail of other project evaluations and showed a large absolute-latency shift relative to later cells (the first warmed AI2D Base observation was 2.880 s versus 1.733 s in q45). Because the resulting 1.134x speedup would change the paper operating-point interpretation, one quiescent rerun is required.

decision_rule.reporting: Preserve and report both the original concurrent-run estimate and the quiescent rerun regardless of direction or magnitude.
decision_rule.paper_runtime_value: Use the quiescent rerun for the q10 runtime sensitivity row if integrity checks pass; do not alter the q10 quality result, policy, Pareto acceptance rule, or any other cell.
